system.description:
You must have «Resurrection» in order to acquire this skill. You may immediately use «Resurrection».

(SR2): When you use this skill, «Resurrection» may be used with [Range: 4 Sq.]

A magic that simplifies the resurrection magic chant ritual and resurrects allies at any time. You can see the battle situation, take advantage of the enemy's openings and call out the souls of your allies.
